thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall premarket, led by Boeing and Apple

title: All 30 Dow stocks fall premarket, led by Boeing and Apple
text: https://www.marketwatch.com/story/all-30...st=markets The 393-point tumble in Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.56% futures prices YMZ8, -1.54% is unanimous, as all 30 Dow components are trading lower in the premarket. The biggest decliner is Boeing Co.'s stock BA, -4.68% which fell 4.7% to put it on track to open at the lowest level since Jan. 5. The next biggest loser is Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, -3.58% which tumbled 3.9% toward a 6 1/2-month low, putting it on track to open in bear-market territory. Among other big decliners, shares of Visa Inc. V, -3.27% shed 3.3%, Nike Inc. NKE, -3.17% lost 2.8%, Microsoft Corp MSFT, -2.31% fell 2.9% and Home Depot Inc. HD, -3.00% gave up 2.9%. Quote
